name: Children's Discovery Museum
description: Children's Discovery Museum of San Jose is one of the largest children's museums in the country, featuring interactive exhibits that inspire children to explore, question, and discover the world around them.
fullDescription: Children's Discovery Museum of San Jose is one of the largest children's museums in the country, featuring interactive exhibits that inspire children to explore, question, and discover the world around them.
whatTheyOffer:
- Museums for All: $5 per person for up to 4 people
- Valid with a CalFresh EBT or SNAP EBT card plus photo ID
- Infants under 1: Free admission
- Regular admission: $22 per person ($20 seniors 60+)
howToGetIt: Buy Museums for All tickets in person at the museum (no advance reservations needed; a set number are available each session). Show your photo ID and a valid, unexpired CalFresh or SNAP EBT card. EBT cards cannot be used for payment; the museum accepts cash and major credit cards. School-year hours are Tuesday-Friday 9:30 am-1 pm and Saturday-Sunday 9:30 am-4:30 pm.
keywords: Children's Discovery Museum, San Jose, kids, interactive exhibits, Museums for All, EBT $5, CalFresh, SNAP, family
